messages:
maria: quick heads-up — ran `npm audit` on console/ui main after a flaky CI build. got a high-severity vuln in `braces` (CVE-2026-XXXXX) pulled in by fast-glob -> micromatch. appears to be a regex DoS in the parser.

jake: is `braces` in prod bundle or only dev tooling?

maria: it's a transitive in our build pipeline (webpack/fast-glob) so not in runtime code shipped to client, but it runs in CI builders and could be exploited in CI if someone publishes a crafted path during a build step. still high risk for supply-chain.

olivia: can we upgrade fast-glob/micromatch to versions that depend on patched `braces`? any break risk for lockfile churn?

maria: preliminary check: fast-glob@3.2.7 -> micromatch@4.x -> braces@>=3.0. patched exists in braces@3.0.1. we can do `pnpm up fast-glob@^3.2.7 --lockfile-only` and run CI.

sam: propose emergency triage: (1) patch devDeps now, (2) open minimal PR with only package.json + lockfile changes, (3) run a quick smoke build in a sandboxed job. avoids touching runtime deps.

jake: agree. who owns the PR? I can take it. will create branch `sec/patch-braces-2026` and push minimal change.

maria: thx. also recommend adding an `audit-ci` gate for the console repo so builds fail on high/critical going forward. low-friction rule: fail CI on severity >= high for deps used during build.

olivia: +1 for audit gate. but we should avoid noisy failures from transitive devDeps — maybe only apply to packages that run during CI (build/test). we'll need a small script to enumerate those.

sec-bot: noted. I've created ticket SEC-4822 to track and enforce the audit gate and backports.

jake: opened PR #4827 with package updates: bumped fast-glob and micromatch, lockfile updated (pnpm-lock.yaml). CI job `build:sandbox` passed. plz review — small churn: lockfile + one package.json pin.

maria: quick review done. lgtm. small ask: include a changelog line and reference SEC-4822 in PR body.

olivia: one more thing — we need to consider backport to `release/1.x` since some customers still pin the old console image that triggers the build. i'd say P1 for backport.

sam: timeline: patch PR merged within 24h, backport PR opened and merged within 72h. vulnerability disclosure team informed?

maria: I've pinged infosec-disclosure@redwood on the impact. will deny public disclosure until patches land.

dependabot: PRs may also be created automatically. note: we turned off auto-merge for devDeps last quarter due to churn.

jake: merging now. will coordinate with release for backport and create minimal backport PR that only updates lockfile entries and package pins — avoids unrelated churn.

olivia: for the longer term: let's add a script in devex that flags critical transitive deps in the build graph and produces a compact list. reduces triage time.

maria: agreed. filing a follow-up: DEVEX-211 to prototype `build-dep-graph-audit`.

sam: thanks everyone. summary: patched dev-toolchain transitive `braces` vuln, merged minimal PR, backport in progress, audit gate + follow-ups filed. closing thread after backport merged. :white_check_mark:
